about.title: About Me
about.description: Graduate of SMK Negeri 1 Surabaya majoring in Software Engineering and active Information Systems student at Universitas Terbuka (3rd semester). Experienced in building full-stack web applications using Next.js, Laravel, and PostgreSQL, focusing on REST API development, multi-tenant architecture, and web performance optimization.

universitasTerbuka.title: Universitas Terbuka
universitasTerbuka.content: Pursuing higher education in Information Systems (3rd semester) to deepen expertise in programming, database architecture, and enterprise system analysis and management.

smkn1Surabaya.title: State Vocational High School 1 Surabaya
smkn1Surabaya.content: Gained a solid foundation in software engineering, algorithms, databases, as well as desktop and web application development.

sobatUmkm.title: Sobat UMKM Pro — Sidoarjo
sobatUmkm.content:
• Developed ProMaP (Project Management Platform), a multi-tenant SaaS application for employee action plans, proposals, and project timeline monitoring.
• Designed REST APIs with JWT authentication, 4-level RBAC, and multi-tenant company data isolation.
• Optimized page performance using Server Components, caching, dynamic imports, and Suspense.
• Built Randumart e-commerce website (herbal products, umrah souvenirs, gifts) featuring dynamic Bundling, Hampers, and Promo Banners.

arfaNusantara.title: CV. Arfa Nusantara Teknologi — Surabaya
arfaNusantara.content:
• Developed employee attendance status web application using Laravel and Vue.js.
• Built and maintained REST APIs for robust frontend-backend integration.
• Optimized backend performance through query optimization and caching.
• Designed responsive user interfaces with Vue.js and Bootstrap.

promap.title: ProMaP — Project Management Platform (2026)
promap.description: Multi-tenant SaaS application for managing employee action plans, proposals, and project timeline monitoring.
features: 4-level RBAC (Super Admin, Operational Admin, Manager, PIC)
Server Components + caching for optimal performance
Kanban Board, Gantt Calendar, and PDF Export
In-app notification system + automated overdue cron jobs

randumart.title: Randumart — E-Commerce Website (2026)
randumart.description: E-commerce platform for herbal goods, umrah souvenirs, and gifts with checkout via WhatsApp.
features: Bundling & Hamper features with automated stock management
Dynamic Promo Banner system (Flash Sale, Percent Discount, Custom)
Order state machine (PENDING → PAID → SHIPPED → COMPLETED)
Auto-increment rating & reviewCount upon order PAID
